name: Lower A — Heavy Strength
brief: The money session. Warm up properly, lift heavy, leave crisp.

name: Upper — Build
brief: Push/pull balance, moderate reps, 1–2 in reserve. Zero cost to the legs.

name: Lower B + Core — Durability
brief: Sub-maximal by design. Quality movement; protect tomorrow’s long run.

name: Lower A — Heavy Maintenance
brief: Strength stays, volume drops — running is peaking.

name: Upper — Build
brief: Unchanged — this session never interferes.

name: Race Builder — Pack & Carry
brief: The race in miniature: load, climb, descend, carry, stabilise.

name: Taper — Maintain
brief: One crisp session a week. Nothing that causes soreness. Last real session ~10 days out.

name: Optional — Easy Upper
brief: Week 2 post-race only, and only if you genuinely want to move.

name: Lower — Strength & Shape
brief: Hypertrophy dial up: 8–12 reps, close to failure, full range.

name: Upper — Push Bias
brief: Press-heavy day. Chase clean reps, add small weight often.

name: Full Body — Pull Bias + Core
brief: Back, hinge and trunk. Optional 4th short upper day mid-week if recovery is good.

name: Mobility & Lower Back
brief: Spine-sparing back work — McGill's Big 3 plus glutes — bracketed by hip and T-spine mobility. Your Mon/Wed/Fri twenty minutes.
